evals.prompt: Build chatqna backend and ui images from source with default tags.
evals.expected_output: Provides direct docker build commands for backend and UI from the sample root with default tag behavior.
expectations: Runs from sample-applications/chat-question-and-answer-core or equivalent project root context.
Uses docker build -f docker/Dockerfile for OpenVINO backend image.
Uses docker build -f ui/Dockerfile ui/ for UI image.
Uses resulting image names chatqna and chatqna-ui with default latest tags when not overridden.

evals.prompt: Build OpenVINO GPU backend variant for chatqna.
evals.expected_output: Uses the OpenVINO Dockerfile with USE_GPU build argument for the GPU variant and preserves canonical image naming.
expectations: Uses docker build with --build-arg USE_GPU=true.
Builds with docker/Dockerfile as source of truth for OpenVINO backend.
Tags resulting backend image as ${REGISTRY}chatqna:${BACKEND_TAG}.
Mentions that reusing the same BACKEND_TAG can overwrite local variant tags.

evals.prompt: Build Ollama backend image and UI image with tag dev.
evals.expected_output: Provides commands to export tags and build the Ollama backend from the dedicated Dockerfile plus UI image.
expectations: Uses docker/Dockerfile.ollama for backend build path.
Includes BACKEND_TAG and UI_TAG exports or equivalent explicit tags set to dev.
Builds backend image as ${REGISTRY}chatqna:${BACKEND_TAG} and UI image as ${REGISTRY}chatqna-ui:${UI_TAG}.
Includes docker build -f ui/Dockerfile ui/ for UI image build.

evals.prompt: Build using docker compose for the active runtime profile only.
evals.expected_output: Uses setup_env profile selection and compose build-only workflow without starting containers.
expectations: Uses source scripts/setup_env.sh with optional -d gpu or -b ollama profile selection.
Uses docker compose -f docker/compose.yaml build.
Keeps action in build-only mode and does not switch to compose up unless explicitly requested.
Treats docker/compose.yaml as canonical for image names and build contexts.

evals.prompt: Set custom registry prefix intel/ and build tags before building images.
evals.expected_output: Configures REGISTRY and tags before build, and reflects resulting canonical image names.
expectations: Includes export REGISTRY with a prefix such as intel/.
Includes export BACKEND_TAG and export UI_TAG before build commands.
States final backend image name pattern ${REGISTRY}chatqna:${BACKEND_TAG}.
States final UI image name pattern ${REGISTRY}chatqna-ui:${UI_TAG}.

evals.prompt: I only want OpenVINO CPU backend image build, not GPU or Ollama.
evals.expected_output: Provides a CPU-only OpenVINO backend build command and avoids GPU or Ollama build paths.
expectations: Uses docker build -t ${REGISTRY}chatqna:${BACKEND_TAG} -f docker/Dockerfile . for CPU path.
Does not include --build-arg USE_GPU=true for this request.
Does not switch to docker/Dockerfile.ollama for this request.

evals.prompt: Verify that requested chatqna images were built correctly.
evals.expected_output: Provides post-build verification commands to confirm images and compose service definitions.
expectations: Includes docker images with filtering for chatqna and chatqna-ui.
Includes docker compose -f docker/compose.yaml config --services.
Reports resulting local tags against requested REGISTRY and tags.

evals.prompt: Build with proxy settings inherited from environment.
evals.expected_output: Preserves proxy environment usage for Docker builds and compose builds without introducing unrelated deployment actions.
expectations: References use of http_proxy, https_proxy, and no_proxy as build-time inherited variables.
Keeps commands focused on build workflow.
Does not require Helm or runtime deployment commands for this request.

evals.prompt: Are Makefile targets the source of truth for this build flow?
evals.expected_output: Clarifies that Dockerfiles and docker/compose.yaml are the build source of truth for this skill.
expectations: States that docker/Dockerfile, docker/Dockerfile.ollama, ui/Dockerfile, and docker/compose.yaml are the canonical build sources.
Avoids treating Makefile as source of truth for this skill behavior.

evals.prompt: What are prerequisites before running chatqna image builds?
evals.expected_output: Lists core prerequisites and runtime caveats relevant to build and subsequent usage.
expectations: Requires Docker engine availability.
Requires Docker Compose plugin availability.
Mentions GPU host or runtime support caveat for later /dev/dri usage when building GPU variants.

evals.prompt: Build OpenVINO GPU and then Ollama backend using the same BACKEND_TAG=latest.
evals.expected_output: Warns about local tag overwrite behavior when building multiple backend variants with the same tag.
expectations: Explicitly warns that latest build can overwrite the local backend tag if BACKEND_TAG is reused.
Suggests using distinct backend tags when keeping multiple variants side by side.

evals.prompt: After build, summarize what was built and suggest next actions.
evals.expected_output: Reports built image results and provides clear next actions aligned to deploy or push workflows.
expectations: Summarizes which runtime or images were built successfully.
Reports resulting image tags.
Provides practical next action such as deploy with docker compose or push to registry.
